how: We read the website of every Orlando wedding planner listed on Lazo (74 listings, 49 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: decor houses and rental companies, venues that sell coordination, a nonprofit, hair-and-makeup package sellers, a national multi-service franchise, and a downtown event space. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Full planning, partial, or month-of only? Ask what each tier includes in meetings and in hours on the day.
Have you run a wedding at a Disney or resort property, and what did their vendor rules change about the plan?
What is the backup plan for a June-to-November wedding if a hurricane watch is issued that week?

picks.name: Just Marry!
picks.blurb: Just Marry! has planned Orlando weddings since 1992 and is woman-owned and locally focused. The team handles everything from small Orlando weddings and elopements to Disney weddings, with full-service planning and day-of options laid out on the site.

picks.name: Diamond Receptions - Event Planning & Design
picks.blurb: Diamond Receptions was founded in 2007 by a planner who was previously marketing and special events director at a local Chamber of Commerce. Full, partial and day-of coordination, with a pitch about being the planner who actually answers when you text.

picks.name: Bella Sposa Events
picks.blurb: Jennifer Lopez founded Bella Sposa Events in 2016 after an interior design degree in 2011 and a career start at a Winter Park design firm. Based in Altamonte Springs, with base coordination beginning at $2,400 and custom collections above that.

picks.name: White Rabbit Event Planning & Photo Booths
picks.blurb: White Rabbit plans weddings for couples who want something one-of-a-kind, led by Jennifer, who holds a bachelor's in event management from UCF Rosen College. The process starts with taking time to understand you and your fiance from the start, out of Winter Park.

picks.name: Eilah Events | Wedding Planner, Orlando, Miami, Tampa and Beyond!
picks.blurb: Eilah Events is a luxury planner for Orlando, South Florida, Puerto Rico and destination weddings, run by a Latina planner who started in 2016 assisting on weddings from many cultures. Authentic moments and curated details are the brand's own words.

picks.name: Immaculate Events, LLC
picks.blurb: Dieudonne is founder and creative director of Immaculate Events, an Orlando luxury wedding and event planning company. From Miami, with a Southern mother and Caribbean father, Dieudonne credits a grandmother and mother who were hostesses with the mostest for the love of planning.

picks.name: Elite Celebrations Florida LLC
picks.blurb: Valeria Blanco founded Elite Celebrations, an Orlando wedding, quinceanera and corporate event planner with a trilingual team and a published list of Orlando venue partners. Planning, design and production from one studio.

picks.name: Amore Events II & Consulting
picks.blurb: Amore Events II was created after its founder saw firsthand how stressful a wedding day becomes when details fall through the cracks. Full-service planning and event design out of Casselberry, with centerpieces from its own inventory.

picks.name: Nikun Events
picks.blurb: Nikun Events is a boutique design and production studio with two decades and hundreds of weddings behind it, treating each event as a work of design. Full-service and design-only engagements, including cultural celebrations, based in Orlando and working across Florida.

picks.name: Party Life Productions
picks.blurb: Shanae Hall, known as Miss Party Life, is owner and lead planner at Party Life Productions, serving Orlando and Jacksonville. Proposals are customized after a chat, and couples planning a micro wedding under 10 guests are invited to email directly.

picks.name: Elope to Orlando | Elope to Florida
picks.blurb: Mya and Hector founded Elope to Orlando and have helped thousands of couples with intimate weddings and elopements since 2004. Packages pair hand-selected venues with planning, and the founders are also the photographers.

picks.name: Eventus Royale LLC
picks.blurb: Eventus, led by Dr Heena Kausar Shaik, pairs Orlando wedding and private event planning with its own inventory of tables, chairs and rental accessories, pitched as an all-in-one solution.
